note: Old item URLs and where they now live. Titles derive the slug, so renaming an entry in Contentful retires its URL; recording the move here keeps the old link working. src/_redirects.liquid turns these into Netlify 301s and build:c-verify refuses to build if an alias points nowhere.
howToAddOne: Rename in Contentful, then add "<old-slug>": "<new-slug>" under the right type. Chains are resolved automatically, so an older alias pointing at the slug you just retired keeps working.
